text.en:
Item III (f), for the Province of Cebu, page two hundred five of Republic Act Numbered Twenty hundred and ninety-three, is hereby amended to read as follows:
III "(f) Ocaña Elementary School, Carcar Construction of one additional room ₱6,000.00 "(f) Standard shop building, Noel-type, size: 6.90 X 8.55, Carcar Construction ₱6,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
